verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents repeatable multi-step workflows. Its Cloud UI has a drag-and-drop block builder with shareable templates, and the code-first SDK builds multi-step automations on Playwright. It can also turn recorded actions or SOPs into reusable workflows. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly mentions loop blocks, conditional branching, or workflow parameters, so the core composition primitives the story asks for are unproven. Missing for 10: documented loop/iteration blocks, conditional/branching logic, workflow input parameters, independent hands-on corroboration of workflow composition.
